name: Coinbase BTC/USD near-touch depth imbalance
description: For each fresh reconstructed Coinbase level-two book, bid and ask base size are summed inside an inclusive five-basis-point band around that book's midpoint. The five-basis-point band is an initial research threshold that requires empirical calibration. The Coinbase input is the full displayed level-two book this repository reconstructs locally. imbalance equals (bid depth minus ask depth) divided by total depth. Ready output requires a complete positive uncrossed Coinbase book no more than 10 seconds old and positive observable depth on both sides. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Coinbase inputs and is ready whenever the Coinbase book is complete, uncrossed, and inside the staleness bound, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
